summary: This standards-track document extends IMAP so a server can search mail with inexact matching. The server also gives each matching message a relevancy score, so the best matches can be shown first. It is meant for typical search where spelling and word forms vary.

eli5.summary: Instead of finding only exact words, your mail program can ask for messages that roughly match and sort them from best to worst, like a search engine does.

questions: how to rank imap search results
